content.text:
The data shows the Core_mid zone's lower temperature bound jumped to exactly 24.0 °C (the cooling setpoint) after July 2018, while the other F3 zones' lower bounds only shifted from ~16-17 °C to ~19-20 °C. All setpoints are unchanged. So the core is now essentially pinned at the cooling setpoint for a large fraction of the day.

Both "local load change" (zone genuinely hotter / VAV stuck maxing out) and "zone sensor fault" (reported value biased high by ~1–2 °C, hitting the same cooling setpoint) are consistent with this temperature-only signature. The distinguishing evidence — VAV damper position / air flow / valve command (which would rise under true increased cooling demand) — is not in the data store for this zone, and neither is an independent reference temperature. Without those I can't tell whether the reported increase reflects actual zone temperature (load change) or an inflated sensor reading (fault).
